verdict.rationale: Neon documents database-per-user/agent/version as a first-class workload. It says platforms manage tens of thousands, even millions, of projects through the Neon API, with creation, configuration and cleanup fully automated, and idle databases incur no ongoing compute because of scale-to-zero. Fleet control is backed by an OpenAPI-specified Management API (probed live), a CLI, an MCP server with project and branch lifecycle tools, scoped API keys, and per-branch isolation with auto-expiring TTLs. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of fleet operation at thousands-of-databases scale, and concrete per-database cost data at that scale (the only pricing item shown is a 100-project plan limit).
